title: Bug: Android export with multiple architectures fails when GDExtension includes native dependencies
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.stable, 4.5.1.rc1

### System information

OS: macOS (Apple Silicon / arm64)
Build Tools: Android SDK Build-Tools 35.0.0 
NDK: 28.1.13356709  Java: OpenJDK 17  
Export target: Android (Multi-ABI: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a)

### Issue description

When exporting a Godot project for Android with multiple architectures enabled (e.g. arm32 + arm64), and a GDExtension that declares native .so dependencies (like libcrypto.so from OpenSSL), the export fails at the APK signing stage with:

```
Exception in thread "main" com.android.apksig.apk.ApkFormatException: Multiple ZIP entries with the same name: lib/armeabi-v7a/libcrypto.so
	at com.android.apksig.ApkSigner.parseZipCentralDirectory(ApkSigner.java:939)
	at com.android.apksig.ApkSigner.sign(ApkSigner.java:282)
	at com.android.apksig.ApkSigner.sign(ApkSigner.java:237)
	at com.android.apksig.ApkSignerTool.sign(ApkSignerTool.java:425)
	at com.android.apksig.ApkSignerTool.main(ApkSignerTool.java:94)

```
The error only occurs when more than one ABI is selected.
If exporting for a single ABI (e.g. arm64 only), the export succeeds.

For some reason, when multiple architectures are selected the dependencies seems to cause this issue. Even if the libcrypto.so binaries are different and also in different paths.


This issue only exists when there are dependencies present in the gdextension as below.
```
[configuration]

entry_symbol = "sqlite_library_init"
compatibility_minimum = 4.1

[libraries]

ios.debug = ""
ios.release = ""
macos.debug = "res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgdsqlite.macos.template_debug.framework"
macos.release = "res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgdsqlite.macos.template_release.framework"
android.debug.arm32 = "res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgdsqlite.android.template_debug.arm32.so"
android.release.arm32 = "res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgdsqlite.android.template_release.arm32.so"
android.debug.arm64 = "res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgdsqlite.android.template_debug.arm64.so"
android.release.arm64 = "res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgdsqlite.android.template_release.arm64.so"

[dependencies]

ios.debug = {
"res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgodot-cpp.ios.template_debug.xcframework": ""
}
ios.release = {
"res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/libgodot-cpp.ios.template_release.xcframework": ""
}
android.debug.arm32 = {
"res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/openssl/arm32/lib/libcrypto_arm32.so": ""
}
android.release.arm32 = {
"res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/openssl/arm32/lib/libcrypto_arm32.so": ""
}
android.debug.arm64 = {
"res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/openssl/arm64/lib/libcrypto.so": ""
}
android.release.arm64 = {
"res://addons/godot-sqlite/bin/openssl/arm64/lib/libcrypto.so": ""
}

```


### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce

1. Download the MRP.
2. Install android build template.
3. Export for android with multiple architectures selected.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22769855/mrp.zip)
